infotexts.entitydescription.SAFS_manual: A comprehensive guide that provides detailed instructions for building the S.A.F.S Exosuit. It also includes information about the materials and core components essential to the nanochip technology.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoSmash: Allows the user to slam down with increased force and delivers a brutal finisher.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoCutter: Powerful tool used for cutting through metal and other materials.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoSpray: Multifunctional device primarily used for extinguishing fires and repairing damaged structures.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoRepulsor: Unleashing powerful energy blasts to incapacitate foes.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoFlare: Specialized in providing illumination in low-light environments.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoSticky: Anti-surface explosive designed for safe and effective indoor breaching.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoFlamer: Powerful weapon that unleashes torrents of flame, incinerating enemies in its path.
infotexts.entitydescription.Exojet: An underwater enhancement for swift navigation and agile maneuvers.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoShield: Offers protection from harm while allowing players to inflict damage on enemies during charging runs.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoRepair: A multifunctional tool designed for efficient repairs
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoNet: Shoots a net that captures human targets
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoFreeze: Freezes the target and shatters it into icy shards.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoGravity: Lift targets and launch them as projectiles
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoCute: Unleashes an electric shockwave that paralyzes enemies within range.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoVulcan_earth: Arm-mounted weapon that delivers rapid-fire streams, fueled by the S.A.F.S. power source and chaingun ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoVulcan_dark: Arm-mounted weapon that delivers rapid-fire streams, fueled by the S.A.F.S. power source and chaingun ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoBlaster_dark: Arm-mounted weapon firing single or burst shots, fueled by the S.A.F.S. power source and coilgun ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoBlaster_green: Arm-mounted weapon firing single or burst shots, fueled by the S.A.F.S. power source and coilgun ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoDrill: Arm-mounted drill that penetrates various materials
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoBlade: Arm-mounted blade designed for close combat and lethal finishing strikes
infotexts.entitydescription.ExoCloak: Enables the user to adapt to their surroundings, making them difficult to spot.
